topbar.style: matte gray-brown with a small yellow turn flag; aligned to approved reference proportions and silhouettes, not pixel-identical

city_styles.tier_II_availability_rule: availability is supplied by game rules; zero remaining is never executable even when used_flag is false

slicing.compact_control_note: Use dedicated stepper-frame with matching stepper-fill-default/hover/pressed/disabled for small controls; button-frame uses [24,18,24,18] with minimum height 38.

topbar_overrides.topbar_frame: Full-width bottom separator 4 px; not a nine-slice frame.
topbar_overrides.right_cluster: Uniform whole-group scale; do not nine-slice or stretch its three internal controls independently.

notes: Five entrepreneur slots are display capacity, not a gameplay limit.
Core command tower is exactly one cell: one-based row 3 column 2.
Card-pile counts and sample card art are illustrative until bound to game state.
Layout parameters are engine independent and do not claim a fully implemented game UI.
